blocks.prompt: 7 Find the minimum distance of the point \(P(3\cos\theta, 2\sin\theta)\) on the ellipse from the centre of the ellipse.
blocks.explanation:
Point parametric shakal mein diya gaya hai; pehle pehchanein ke yeh kis ellipse par hai aur us ka centre kahan hai.
Phir centre se point ka faasla \(\theta\) ke function ki shakal mein likhenge.
Faasle ka square minimise karna aasaan hai (root se jaan chhoot jati hai), aur jahan square sab se chhota ho wahin faasla bhi sab se chhota hota hai.
Plan: \(|OP|^2\) ko \(\cos^2\theta\) mein likh kar dekhein ke yeh kab sab se chhota hota hai.
Yaad rakhiye ke centre se sab se qareeb point minor axis ke kinare par hota hai; hum hisaab se yahi dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P(3\cos\theta, 2\sin\theta)\).
Maloom karna: centre se P ka sab se kam faasla.
Tareeqa: \(x = 3\cos\theta\), \(y = 2\sin\theta\) ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\) ko poora karte hain, jis ka centre \(O(0, 0)\) hai.

Ellipse pehchanein
\[\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{y^2}{4} = \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\]
Kyun: \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\) wali identity. Yani \(a = 3\), \(b = 2\).

Centre se faasla
\[|OP|^2 = 9\cos^2\theta + 4\sin^2\theta\]
\[= 4(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta) + 5\cos^2\theta\]
\[= 4 + 5\cos^2\theta\]
Kyun: \(O\) se distance formula. Phir \(9 = 4 + 5\) likha taa ke identity laga kar sirf ek trig term (\(\cos^2\theta\)) bache.

Sab se kam qeemat
Kyunke \(0 \le \cos^2\theta \le 1\),
\[4 \le |OP|^2 \le 9\]
\[|OP|_{\min} = \sqrt{4} = 2\]
Kyun: \(4 + 5\cos^2\theta\) sab se chhota tab hai jab \(\cos^2\theta = 0\), yani \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ya \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\); tab \(P = (0, \pm 2)\).
Dhyan dein: jawab \(|OP|^2 = 4\) nahi, faasla \(\sqrt{4} = 2\) hai.

Ek nazar mein
\(9 = 4 + 5\) likhne wali chaal (trick) yaad rakhiye: is se do trig terms ki jagah ek hi term \(\cos^2\theta\) bachta hai, jis ki hadd \(0\) se \(1\) tak sab ko maloom hai. Is tarah calculus ke baghair hi minimum mil gaya.

Tasdeeq
Sab se qareeb points minor axis ke kinare hain, faasla \(b = 2\); sab se door vertices \((\pm 3, 0)\), faasla \(a = 3\).
Kyun: tasweer mein bhi yahi nazar aata hai: ellipse centre ke sab se qareeb apni chhoti axis par hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: Minimum distance \(= 2\) units, at the points \((0, \pm 2)\)
